backtest.text: Backtest (run in 2013–2019 on every filer's data as of then, 2,274 outcomes): the 80% range of revenue three years out held 81% of what happened (10% fell below it, 10% above) — about right. Loss-makers' operating margin three years out: inside its 80% range 71% of the time (448 outcomes).
